description: Supplier verification mechanism. No false claims — only verified status shown.

visual_verified.label: Visual Verified
visual_verified.description: Factory existence confirmed through visual documentation including photos of facility, production lines, and quality control areas.

document_verified.label: Document Verified
document_verified.description: Business registration, export license, and quality certifications reviewed and confirmed.

factory_verified.label: Factory Verified
factory_verified.description: On-site factory audit completed. Production capacity, quality systems, and export capability confirmed through physical inspection.

partner_verified.label: Partner Verified
partner_verified.description: Established supply relationship with proven track record of successful deliveries and buyer satisfaction.

current_status.note: Verification data is populated as factories are onboarded. Current counts are zero as no factories have been formally onboarded into the V2 system.

disclaimer: All verification claims are subject to periodic review. HISVIA does not guarantee supplier performance. Verification indicates that the described process has been completed; it does not guarantee future results.
rules: Never display verification status that has not been completed
If no data exists, show 'Verification in progress'
Update verification status only after documented completion
